topic: GPT-6 Developer Preparation Guide 2026: API, Pricing & Migration

competitors.title: GPT-6 Review 2026: OpenAI's New Flagship Model — Benchmarks, API, and Developer Use Cases
key_points: GPT-6 pre-training completed March 24, 2026 at Stargate facility (Abilene, TX) using 100K+ liquid-cooled H100 and B200 GPUs — a $500B infrastructure bet
GPT-5.5 (codenamed 'Spud') shipped April 23, 2026 as GPT-5.5 NOT GPT-6 — OpenAI reserved the '6' label for a more fundamental architectural shift
GPT-6 remains in post-training (RLHF, safety evaluation, red-teaming) as of May 2026
Polymarket: 84% odds of public release by December 31, 2026; developer preview likely Q3 2026
Confirmed features: long-term memory across sessions (Altman's #1 priority), agentic RL training
Speculated: 2M token context window, System-1/System-2 dual inference pipeline, MoE architecture
GPT-5.5 benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.0 82.7%, SWE-Bench Pro 58.6%, Intelligence Index 60
GPT-6 projected: HumanEval >95%, MATH ~85%, SWE-Bench Pro ~75-80% (40%+ improvement claimed)
Expected API changes: session_id or memory_context parameter replacing full history injection
Recommended strategy: 'Build with GPT-5.5 now, architect for GPT-6' — wrap context in abstraction layer

competitors.title: GPT-6 Release Date: No Official Date, 7 Signals for 2026

Developer prep checklist: state abstraction, token budget modeling, checkpoint documentation, vendor neutrality, context window testing

competitors.title: OpenAI API Pricing Guide 2026: GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Every Model Compared
key_points: GPT-5 pricing: $1.25/$10 per M input/output tokens with 272K context window
GPT-5 Mini: $0.25/$2 per M tokens — 5x cheaper than GPT-5, 66% faster (68 tok/s)
GPT-4o Mini handles 80% of use cases at 6% of GPT-5's cost
Hybrid strategy recommended: GPT-4o Mini for autocomplete/boilerplate, GPT-5 for complex reasoning
Batch API offers 50% discount for non-real-time workloads (24-hour processing)
Hidden costs: system prompt overhead, conversation history compounding, token counting surprises
At startup scale (1K req/day): GPT-4o Mini $13.50/mo vs GPT-5 $750/mo — 55x difference
GPT-6 pricing speculation: competitive with Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 pricing tiers

competitors.title: OpenAI Model Deprecation Guide 2026: Migrating from GPT-4o, GPT-4.1 & o4-mini
key_points: GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and o4-mini retired from ChatGPT February 2026
OpenAI consolidating around GPT-5 family — maintaining multiple generations costs compute
GPT-4o → GPT-5 is simplest swap: change model string, identical API format
GPT-5 is stricter about JSON schema validation for function calling — test schemas
GPT-5 supports max_completion_tokens parameter (preferred over max_tokens)
Historical pattern: ChatGPT retirement → API deprecation notice in 1-3 months → shutdown in 3-6 months
Recommendation: Use multi-provider API gateway to avoid vendor lock-in next deprecation cycle
GPT-5 handles function calling with stricter schema validation — additionalProperties: false enforced
